verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.langchain.com that indexes LangSmith documentation, and Markdown versions of pages (e.g. home.md) that point agents back to that index. A LangSmith-specific llms.txt is also cited for content such as Agent Auth and Agent Server tuning. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on how agents should consume these docs, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
